# ShowIf

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders its child only on the pages a predicate accepts.

The predicate sees a [`PageContext`](page-context.md) - the page number and whether this is the first or last page - and nothing else, so the decision stays a pure function of where the element landed. That is what keeps layout deterministic and what lets the same document produce the same pages in both implementations.

Most useful inside a page template, where the same tree is built for every page:



`isLastPage` is only reliable in the second layout pass; on the first pass the engine does not yet know the total page count.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ShowIf()
new ShowIf(options: ShowIfOptions)
new ShowIf(predicate: PagePredicate, child?: IElement)
```

## Properties

- [`predicate`](#predicate): The page test.

### `predicate`

```typescript
predicate?: PagePredicate | undefined
```

*optional*

The page test. Unset means "always render", so a `ShowIf` with no predicate is a transparent wrapper rather than an element that silently disappears.
